title: Seedream promotion and clearer Pollen estimates
summary:
Seedream got a year-end promotion, Model Monitor gained an hour-long view, and Pollen balance checks stopped calling Polar on every request.

Enter added 99%-off promotion messaging for `seedream` and `seedream-pro`, with an announced end of December 31, 2025. The Pollen FAQ now calculates generation examples from model pricing data instead of relying on fixed estimates; the pricing page also received small layout updates.

Model Monitor now defaults to a 60-minute view of request counts, status codes, and latency. A segmented control keeps the existing 5-minute view available when the last hour is too much history.

Donjon.studio joined the games directory with AI-generated interactive adventures. App submission checks now handle names with special characters and give rejected submissions a reason. React hook docs also correct the default seed to `42` and explain reproducible generation.

highlights.title: An hour of model health
highlights.text: View model request counts, status codes, and latency over the past 60 minutes, or switch back to the 5-minute view. [Open Model Monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).
